summary: Sequence of the SandboxAuditMiddleware wrap_tool_call hook lifecycle for bash tool calls: _pre_process runs _validate_input, _classify_command and _write_audit, then the block/warn/pass verdicts drive _build_block_message, the bash handler, or _append_warn_to_result to produce the final ToolMessage.
mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
    participant Agent as LangGraph agent
    participant MW as wrap_tool_call hook
    participant PP as _pre_process
    participant VP as _validate_input
    participant CL as _classify_command
    participant AU as _write_audit
    participant H as bash handler
    participant BM as _build_block_message
    participant AW as _append_warn_to_result

    Agent->>MW: wrap_tool_call ToolCallRequest name=bash
    MW->>PP: _pre_process request
    PP->>VP: _validate_input command
    alt empty/oversized/null byte
        VP-->>PP: reject_reason
        PP->>AU: _write_audit verdict=block truncate
        PP-->>MW: command thread_id block reject_reason
        MW->>BM: _build_block_message reason
        BM-->>Agent: ToolMessage status=error
    else valid input
        VP-->>PP: None
        PP->>CL: _classify_command command
        CL-->>PP: verdict
        PP->>AU: _write_audit verdict
        PP-->>MW: command thread_id verdict None
        alt verdict=block
            MW->>BM: _build_block_message security violation
            BM-->>Agent: ToolMessage status=error
        else verdict=warn
            MW->>H: handler request
            H-->>MW: ToolMessage result
            MW->>AW: _append_warn_to_result
            AW-->>Agent: ToolMessage + warning
        else verdict=pass
            MW->>H: handler request
            H-->>Agent: ToolMessage result
        end
    end
